description: Use when the user asks how to upgrade, about plans, pricing, what Pro includes, or billing, and when they hit a free limit. Gets checkout links for Barrio Grid Connector Pro: 499 USD a month (first month 249 USD for new subscribers) or 4,990 USD a year (two months free). 5,000 calls a month, the full map, names, MW and dates, and the Pro tools. Also returns Enterprise Lite (999 USD a month total: Pro plus tract search and landowner and appraisal records). Use when the user hits the free limit or asks for more calls or data. Checkout is Stripe and accepts Link. Only buy with the user's explicit approval. The link is tied to the signed-in account, so this same connection becomes Pro as soon as payment clears; nothing to copy or reconnect.

email.description: Optional. Email to prefill at checkout; defaults to the signed-in account's email.
